work_info.title: What is Item Removal in Real Estate Photography?
descriptions: Item Removal is a digital editing process that eliminates unwanted objects, clutter, or distractions from property images. By creating clean, polished visuals, it helps buyers focus on the space itself, making listings appear more spacious, professional, and visually appealing.

list.content: Clutter & Object Removal: Eliminating furniture, appliances, or personal items that distract from the property.
Background & Surface Retouching: Seamlessly filling areas where items were removed for a natural look.
Consistency in Lighting & Shadows: Maintaining realistic lighting after objects are edited out.
Space Optimization Visualization: Making rooms appear larger and more open.
High-Resolution Output: Ensuring edited images retain clarity for web and marketing use.
